description.value: Joe Pesto's is a locally owned and operated wood-fired pizzeria in downtown Squamish, voted best pizza in the city. Their Neapolitan-style pies are baked at 800–900°F in an Italian brick oven, producing a crispy crust with a soft interior, alongside a creative menu spanning classics to inventive specials. Cyclists finishing a ride in the Sea-to-Sky corridor will find a full dine-in experience with local beer and wine on tap, or a quick takeout option to fuel the next leg.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms this is an active, locally owned wood-fired pizzeria in downtown Squamish. The phone number 604.390.0044 appears twice on the website but was absent from OSM tags. Takeout is explicitly offered ('grab one to go'), gluten-free crust and multiple vegetarian pizzas are clearly listed, but no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere in the content.
